items.title: Former UNESCO chief: High expectations for APEC Shenzhen
items.description: The 33rd APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting will be held in Shenzhen from Nov 18 to 19. Irina Bokova, former director-general of UNESCO, told China Daily that Shenzhen's transformation from a fishing village into a bustling metropolis with universities, technology, culture, economy, and finance is remarkable.

items.title: Smart fisheries turn fortunes of Cambodian farmers
items.description: A farmer in Cambodia's Takeo province no longer has to rely on instinct to determine whether his prawns are growing in favorable conditions. With a few taps on his mobile phone, Pros Kh can check water quality readings from his ponds, monitor changes in dissolved oxygen and temperature, and make better-informed decisions about his harvest.
